meta.title: Atanu Debnath (playatanu)
meta.description: Atanu Debnath (playatanu) is an AI Engineer passionate about building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems. His work focuses on computer vision, deep learning, real-time inference, and Edge AI, with a strong interest in developing efficient, reliable, and practical AI solutions.

name: Atanu Debnath
designation: Computer Vision Engineer | Edge AI | Deep Learning
current: Building Edge AI at Emdee Digitronics
about:
I'm a **Computer Vision Engineer** who loves turning research ideas into practical, real time systems. My work spans the full pipeline, data collection, model training and optimization, and deployment, from **multi camera / multi IP (CCTV)** video analytics for real time monitoring, detection, and video processing across many streams, to running models on **Edge AI** devices like **NVIDIA Jetson**, **Rockchip**, and **Radxa**.

I care about building **efficient, reliable, and low latency** solutions, and I enjoy exploring deep learning from first principles, whether that's writing a framework from scratch or squeezing more FPS out of an edge device.

experience.description:
- Working on **Multi IP / CCTV camera**, video analytics for real time monitoring, detection, and video processing. 
- Developing and deploying computer vision applications on **NVIDIA Jetson** for real time edge inference.

- Worked on the complete computer vision pipeline, including data collection, model training, optimization, and deployment. 
- Optimized and deployed models using **ONNX Runtime** and **RKNN** on **Rockchip** and **Radxa** edge devices for efficient, low latency inference.
